Provides a resource to create a vpc route table entry config

> **NOTE:** When setting the route item switch, do not use it together with resource `tencentcloud.Route.TableEntry`.

## Import



vpc route table entry config can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Route/tableEntryConfig:TableEntryConfig example rtb-8425lgjy#rti-4f6efqwn
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
